Feature: greet

  Rule: greet answers what its caller sees

    @succeeds
    Scenario Outline: greet succeeds
      Given <input>
      When greet runs
      Then <expected> is answered

      Examples:
        | name | input | expected |
        | the person named | a names port that holds Ada | hello, Ada |

    @refuses
    Scenario Outline: greet refuses
      Given <input>
      When greet runs
      Then <expected> is refused

      Examples:
        | name | input | expected |
        | an empty name | an empty name | Empty |

    @fails
    Scenario Outline: greet fails
      Given <input>
      When greet runs
      Then <expected> is passed on

      Examples:
        | name | input | expected |
        | a name nobody stored | a name nobody stored | Missing |
